pilot_disclosure: Four pilot sessions ran the lane binary before this file was written, for feasibility only; excluded from all results and not copied into raw/: pilot1 measured (2 warm rounds, 1 oracle round), pilot2 negative (failed: list_windows did not report the task window within 60 attempts; cause not identified), pilot3 negative (4 window attempts; worked), pilot4 smoke. Pilot observations that shaped this file: (a) the oracle works: X RECORD saw exactly 1 ShmGetImage per capture call and 0 otherwise, dbus-monitor saw 142 AT-SPI calls to the fixture per walk and 0 otherwise; (b) in a session started without CUA_SESSION_ATSPI the session bus auto-activates org.a11y.Bus (at-spi-bus-launcher) when the GTK app starts, but org.a11y.atspi.Registry activation fails ('unit failed'), so the walk degrades with atspi_walk_failed; (c) include_screenshot:"false" (string) was accepted and a screenshot returned; (d) the neither row errors with code tool_invocation_failed; unknown_field is refused with invalid_arguments. After the pilots the harness gained a window-search diagnostic record and --window-attempts, and dropped a process-name probe that read system-wide /proc (not session-scoped).
hypothesis_16: On Linux, an omitted modality means its producer did not run (invocation count exactly 0); the remaining modality stays truthful and usable; there is no silent accept-and-ignore; and the metadata distinguishes intentionally omitted from failed/unavailable where the contract supports it.
environment: cua-x11-session.sh: private rootless Xvfb 1920x1080x24, private session dbus, openbox + picom (xrender), scrubbed env, fresh HOME per session. Measured/smoke sessions: CUA_SESSION_ATSPI=1 and CUA_SESSION_EXTRA_ENV="CUA_SESSION_ATSPI=1" (private AT-SPI bus + registryd). Negative session: neither variable set. Driver: jev-use driver_environment() plus CUA_DRIVER_PHASE_TRACE_FILE when marks are on; no permission-mode override, no approval bypass.

row_notes.legacy_omitted: older-schema client: no selector field at all. Contract: both default to true.
row_notes.unknown_field: a selector name the contract does not define. Contract: closed input schema (additionalProperties:false); the registry refuses unknown argument names before the tool runs.
row_notes.wrong_type_supplementary: SUPPLEMENTARY, outside the requested matrix: a defined selector with a non-boolean value. Reported and classified, but NOT counted in the overall #16 disposition.

producer_invocation: Every get_window_state call is attributed to its own marks: the harness drains the trace file before and after the call; capture count = 'enter' marks of capture_window + capture_root_region; walk count = 'enter' marks of atspi_walk. The ordinal n must be gap-free per scope across the session (no unmarked invocation) and every producer mark must lie between that call's get_window_state dispatch_enter and dispatch_exit.
independent_oracle: Producer-boundary oracle that does not use Driver self-report: (1) X server RECORD extension client (python-xlib, temp venv outside the repo) intercepting core GetImage (73) and MIT-SHM ShmGetImage (minor 4) from ALL clients: the requests any window or root capture must send; (2) dbus-monitor --monitor on the private AT-SPI bus, counting method calls whose destination unique name belongs to the fixture pid (resolved via GetConnectionUnixProcessID) and calls sent by the Driver's pid. Run in a separate oracle block after the warm block (it perturbs timing, so it is never timed): 1 s idle window, then 3 rounds of all rows with 250 ms gaps; events attributed to [call start, call end + 30 ms].

matrix_and_n.sessions: 2 isolated measured sessions S1 (rotation 0), S2 (rotation 3), run S1 -> N1 -> S2 -> D1
matrix_and_n.per_session: cold: 1 call per row (rows in rotated order; only the session's first call is process-cold, the rest are first-of-row), recorded separately. warm: 20 rounds; round r calls every row once in order rotated by (rotation + r). oracle: 3 rounds. usability: 1 accessibility-only observation + 1 token click.
matrix_and_n.per_row_total: per row: 2 cold + 40 warm + 6 oracle = 48 calls (42 cold+warm counted for the 21/21 rule, per session)
matrix_and_n.timing_lock: warm block holds flock quiet-lane.lock EXCLUSIVE (the harness converts its SHARED lock); everything else SHARED; loadavg per call; every call kept

record_per_call: capture and walk invocation counts and exit outcomes; producer spans and Driver dispatch/invoke span (from marks); structured key set; content parts (type, bytes, PNG sha256 prefix + IHDR dims); completeness/degraded/error metadata verbatim (META_KEYS); element/coordinate integrity (frames inside window_bounds, screenshot_frames inside the image and equal to (frame - window origin) x frame_scale within 1 px, screenshot dims == window_bounds x frame_scale within 1 px, PNG IHDR == reported dims); elements digest (index, role, label, value, frame); client wall time (monotonic, around session.call_tool); MCP response bytes (client re-serialization of the CallToolResult, compact JSON; disclosed as such); error text.

per_call_selector_outcome.honored: omission row: the omitted modality's fields are absent AND its producer count is 0, and the requested modality is present; default rows: both modalities present and both producers ran once
per_call_selector_outcome.silently_ignored: the request asked to omit a modality but its fields are present (and/or its producer ran)
per_call_selector_outcome.schema_only: the omitted modality's fields are absent but its producer count > 0

controls.positive: row both: capture == 1 and walk == 1 in every cold+warm call of every measured session. Otherwise the counters are broken and the lane STOPS (no disposition).
controls.negative_distinguishability: N1, session without CUA_SESSION_ATSPI: rows both, accessibility_only, screenshot_only; 1 cold + 5 warm rounds. PASS iff for every call that requests accessibility: walk == 1 (the attempt is counted), degraded == true with a non-empty degraded_reason, elements_complete == false; i.e. reported as degraded/unavailable, never as the omission shape (no elements fields).
controls.default_off_smoke: D1: the lane binary with CUA_DRIVER_PHASE_TRACE_FILE unset, then set to an empty string, then set to a file; then the unmodified main binary unset. 3 rounds x all rows each. PASS iff no trace file appears for unset/empty/main and the per-row (structured key set, content part types, is_error) shape sets are identical across all four.

gates.latency_real_selector: row screenshot_only (omitted producer: walk) / accessibility_only (omitted: capture): omitted producer count == 0 in 21/21 cold+warm calls in EACH measured session, AND the remaining modality is complete in every such call, AND the warm wall-time difference of medians (row - both), pooled over both sessions, has a seeded stratified bootstrap 95% CI (10000 resamples, resampling within session, seed 1616) entirely below 0.
gates.remaining_complete_screenshot: image part present; PNG IHDR == screenshot_width x screenshot_height; screenshot_frame_valid true; no screenshot_error; screenshot dims == window_bounds x frame_scale (1 px); capture count == 1.
gates.remaining_complete_accessibility: elements present; elements_complete true; truncated false; no degraded; element_count and elements digest equal to the same session's modal both-row values; 0 frames outside window_bounds; walk count == 1.
gates.schema_only: field omitted from the response but producer count > 0 in any call: #16 FAILURE for that row.
gates.unsupported_ambiguous: refused or degraded without clear metadata, or accepted with the selector silently ignored.
gates.rejected_explicit: rows neither and unknown_field: is_error in every call, capture == walk == 0, and the error text names the offending field(s). Not a failure: the contract defines these as errors. A missing machine-readable code is reported, not gated.
gates.default_honored: row legacy_omitted: capture == 1 and walk == 1 in every call and the structured key set equals the same session's both-row key set.
gates.oracle_corroboration: every oracle call: X RECORD (GetImage + ShmGetImage) count == mark capture count, and (AT-SPI calls to the fixture > 0) iff mark walk == 1; idle window shows 0 of both. Any disagreement makes the counters untrusted: the affected rows are reported BLOCKED (oracle disagreement) instead of a disposition.

decision_rules.overall: KEEP if the positive control passes, every supported omission row (screenshot_only, accessibility_only) is latency_real_selector, neither and unknown_field are rejected_explicit, legacy_omitted is default_honored, and the negative control and smoke pass. REVISE if any matrix row is schema_only or unsupported_ambiguous (list them), or a control other than the positive control fails. KILL only if the remaining modality becomes untruthful (an accessibility-only element set differing from the both-row set, or a screenshot-only image failing the screenshot completeness checks). STOP (no disposition) if the positive control fails.
decision_rules.metadata_distinguishability: Reported per row, not gated: whether omission is signalled explicitly or only by absence, and how failure/unavailability is signalled (negative control).
decision_rules.supplementary: wrong_type_supplementary is classified (honored / rejected / silently_ignored / schema_only) and reported as a separate finding with its own follow-up; it does not change the overall disposition.

statistics: medians and nearest-rank p95 per row (warm), per session and pooled; difference of medians with the stratified bootstrap above; cold calls reported separately and never pooled with warm; response bytes per row; work deleted (producer invocations avoided, oracle AT-SPI calls and X image reads avoided per call) reported separately from wall-clock saved.
claim_boundary: Linux X11 (private Xvfb), private AT-SPI bus, GTK3 9-element task window, Driver 229b65b28 + R2-04 marks + these counting marks. No macOS/Windows parity (BLOCKED on hardware), no Wayland/Hyprland, no other toolkit, no Chromium/Electron, no provider. Timing is per get_window_state call on this fixture, not whole-task time.
invariants: Instrumentation is measurement-only, env-gated, default off (smoke); no schema change, no new service, no observation skipping is introduced or recommended here; marks and events are never an oracle of success or freshness.
